rangers.empty: No rangers listed yet: a load that reaches patrol setup fills this; the viewer's Rangers tab lists the people in the dataset meanwhile.

load.stopsAt_other: The run will write what the plan lists, then stop at the {{count}} blocking findings below until they are fixed.

load.stale: The job stopped without reporting; continue to resume from the last checkpoint.

findings.title: Findings
findings.createdByRun: Will be created by this load: {{title}}

team.title: Create the patrol team {{name}}
team.fix: In Django admin, open Patrol configuration › Teams and add a team whose display is exactly this name. Create every team listed, then press Continue.

roster_group.title: Put the rangers in the roster subject group
roster_group.fix: No roster group was named for this load, or the one named was not found, so the ranger subjects are in no group rangers are picked from. Plan the load again with a roster group, or in Django admin open Patrol configuration › member subject groups, choose or create the group, and add the subjects.

permission_subject_group.title: Add the subjects to the subject group {{group}}
permission_subject_group.fix: The site user cannot change subject-group membership. Grant the user that permission and press Continue, or add the subjects to the group yourself in Django admin › Subject groups.

enable_patrol_schemas.title: Enable the patrol_schemas feature on this site
enable_patrol_schemas.fix: In Django admin, open Preview features › patrol_schemas and enable it for this tenant. Ask EarthRanger Core if the page is not available. Then press Continue.

permission_patrol_types.title: Grant permission: patrol types
permission_patrol_types.fix: The site user cannot create or change patrol types. In Django admin, open Users › the user and add the permission shown. Then press Continue.

permission_segment_schema.title: Grant permission: universal patrol fields
permission_segment_schema.fix: The site user cannot write the universal patrol fields. Add the permission shown; today that needs a superuser. Then press Continue.

permission_subjects.title: Grant permission: subjects
permission_subjects.fix: The site user cannot view, add or change subjects. In Django admin, open Users › the user and add the permission shown. Then press Continue.

permission_patrol_config.title: Grant permission: patrol configuration
permission_patrol_config.fix: The site user cannot read the patrol configuration. In Django admin, open Users › the user and add the permission shown. Then press Continue.

patrol_type_icons.title: Pick an icon for each patrol type
patrol_type_icons.fix: This does not stop the load. The API cannot set icons, so choose one for each new patrol type in EarthRanger admin › Patrol types.

station_names.title: Name the stations SMART left unnamed
station_names.fix: This does not stop the load. These stations have no name in SMART, so they were created with a placeholder. Name them in SMART and export again, or rename the choice in Django admin › Choices.

timezone.title: The timezone {{zone}} was inferred
timezone.fix: SMART did not record the conservation area's timezone, so the extraction inferred it from where the waypoints are. If it is wrong, set SMART_ABLE_TIMEZONE for the extraction and extract the dataset again.

language.title_one: {{count}} data-model element has no label in the chosen language
language.title_other: {{count}} data-model elements have no label in the chosen language
language.fix: They fall back to the bundle's default language. If the labels matter, plan the load again with the best-covered language; the dataset's Data Model tab shows how well each is covered.

time_coverage.title_one: {{count}} leg day has no time information
time_coverage.title_other: {{count}} leg days have no time information
time_coverage.fix: Nothing to do. Their segments cover the whole day.

feature_flag.title: The patrol_schemas feature is off on this site
feature_flag.fix: In Django admin, open Preview features › patrol_schemas and enable it for this tenant. Then press Continue.

permissions.title_one: The site user lacks {{count}} permission the import needs
permissions.title_other: The site user lacks {{count}} permissions the import needs
permissions.fix: Grant each permission listed, in Django admin › Users › the user. Creating events in a category needs that category's create permission, usually granted through a permission set. Then press Continue.

patrol_types.title_one: {{count}} patrol type is missing or inactive
patrol_types.title_other: {{count}} patrol types are missing or inactive
patrol_types.fix: Activate the type in EarthRanger admin › Patrol types, or press Continue to let the load create it again.

segment_schema.title_one: {{count}} universal patrol field is missing or deprecated
segment_schema.title_other: {{count}} universal patrol fields are missing or deprecated
segment_schema.fix: If an admin deprecated a field on purpose, restore it in the patrol form builder. Otherwise press Continue; the load writes these fields.

choices.title_one: {{count}} option the patrols use is missing or inactive
choices.title_other: {{count}} options the patrols use are missing or inactive
choices.fix: This does not stop the load. The load creates missing options; an option an admin switched off can be re-activated in Django admin › Choices.

subjects.title_one: {{count}} patrol member cannot be put on a segment
subjects.title_other: {{count}} patrol members cannot be put on a segment
subjects.fix: Their ranger subjects do not exist, or are in no group listed under Patrol configuration › members. The load creates them and, when a roster group is named, adds them to it. Otherwise add them to such a group in Django admin › Subject groups.

teams.title_one: {{count}} patrol team is missing or inactive
teams.title_other: {{count}} patrol teams are missing or inactive
teams.fix: In Django admin, open Patrol configuration › Teams and add or activate a team whose display is exactly each name shown. Then press Continue.

collection_type.title_one: {{count}} waypoint holds several observations, and the site has no collection event type
collection_type.title_other: {{count}} waypoints hold several observations, and the site has no collection event type
collection_type.fix: This does not stop the load; their events import ungrouped. To group them, add or activate the incident_collection event type in EarthRanger admin › Event types.

observers.title_one: {{count}} observation has nobody who can be named as its reporter
observers.title_other: {{count}} observations have nobody who can be named as their reporter
observers.fix: Nothing to do unless it matters: their events carry no reporter. To change that, give the observer an employee record in SMART and export again.

bundle_warnings.fix: They are listed below and in the bundle's manifest. The SMART data quirks section of the help explains each kind.

leg_span.title_one: {{count}} leg starts on SMART's 1970 placeholder date or spans more than a year ({{days}} leg days as stored)
leg_span.title_other: {{count}} legs start on SMART's 1970 placeholder date or span more than a year ({{days}} leg days as stored)
leg_span.fix: Nothing to do. The load keeps only the leg days that have a track or a waypoint. To correct the dates, fix the leg in SMART and export again.

retired.title_one: {{count}} patrol member is an inactive subject
retired.fix: Nothing to do. EarthRanger accepts only active members on a segment, so the load activates these subjects for the run and deactivates them again when it finishes.

stranded.title_one: {{count}} inactive patrol member is in no member group
stranded.title_other: {{count}} inactive patrol members are in no member group
stranded.fix: Activating them would still leave them off the roster. Add them to a group listed under Patrol configuration › members, in Django admin › Subject groups. Then press Continue.

unmatched.title_one: {{count}} observed SMART category has no active event type on the site
unmatched.title_other: {{count}} observed SMART categories have no active event type on the site
unmatched.fix: The data model has not been pushed under the event category this load uses. Check the event category: if an earlier push used another identifier, plan the load again with that one.

ambiguous.title_one: {{count}} category matches more than one event type
ambiguous.title_other: {{count}} categories match more than one event type
ambiguous.fix: The site has several data model pushes with the same type names. Plan the load again with the event category of the push to import against.

inactive.title_one: {{count}} observed category maps to an inactive event type
inactive.title_other: {{count}} observed categories map to an inactive event type
inactive.fix: This does not stop the load. Their events import against the inactive type, which EarthRanger does not offer for new reports. Activate the type in EarthRanger admin › Event types if rangers should keep using it.

variants.title_one: {{count}} observed category exists only as configurable model variants
variants.title_other: {{count}} observed categories exist only as configurable model variants
variants.fix: The import cannot yet tell which variant an observation belongs to, so these patrols cannot be imported yet.

patrols_failed.fix: Read each error below. If it names a missing team, subject or event type, fix that on the site, then press Continue. Only these patrols are retried.

site_token_rejected.title: The site's token no longer works
site_token_rejected.fix: Nothing was written. Remove the site, register it again with a working token, and start a new load.

progress.title: Progress
progress.continued_one: Continued {{count}} time past the job limit.
progress.continued_other: Continued {{count}} times past the job limit.
progress.reportedBy: {{count}} of the events it handled report who made them
progress.backfilled: {{count}} of them from an earlier load, given one now
progress.leftPhase: about {{dur}} left in this phase, then tracks

plan.title: Plan
plan.none: none: this load is the data model only

help.noEntry: No help entry yet for the finding "{{id}}". The finding's own fix text is the guidance.
help.englishOnly: This section is available in English only.

siteDialog.title: Add an EarthRanger site
siteDialog.hint: The token is checked against the site before it is saved.
siteDialog.name: Name

siteEdit.title: Edit site
siteEdit.hint: Change the name, or replace the token. The site address cannot be changed.
siteEdit.tokenKeep: leave empty to keep the current token

loadDialog.title: Load "{{name}}" into EarthRanger
loadDialog.intro: First a plan is made without writing anything. You confirm it before the site is changed.
loadDialog.modelHint: none: event types for the whole data model. A configurable model (the subset a SMART mobile form uses) makes only its categories and dropdown options active; others that older observations used are kept, inactive, so those observations still load.
loadDialog.rosterPlaceholder: optional; default: the patrol configuration's first member group
loadDialog.categoryHint: Use the identifier an earlier CLI push used, if any (for example, site-xyz).
loadDialog.hintDatamodel: Event types, patrol types and fields, rangers and the roster: what a team needs to patrol and record in EarthRanger. No patrols, observations or tracks.
loadDialog.hintAll: Leave the dates empty to load every patrol. A patrol is in the window when it starts on or between the dates.
loadDialog.windowBackwards: The window starts after it ends.

share.title: Share "{{name}}"
share.note: People you share with can open the dataset. Only you can share, re-extract, or delete it.
share.siteNote: People you share with can load datasets into this site using your token.

confirm.removeSite: Remove "{{name}}"? Loads that reference this site stay readable but cannot be continued; register the site again to load into it.
confirm.deleteLoad: Delete this load's records? Nothing in EarthRanger is removed.
confirm.deleteDatasetWhat: This deletes the uploaded backup, the extracted data, the migration bundles and the load records.
confirm.deleteBackupWhat: This deletes the file {{file}} now. The extracted data, the bundles and the loads stay.
confirm.deleteBackupAfter: To extract again you will have to upload it again.
